scope.resourceCoverage: All released resources must prove advertised language/range/style/capabilities. Language subsets and backend-specific incompatibilities are allowed only in a frozen matrix with a supported tested combination for every mandatory feature.

workload.description: Render one source unit across C4 to G4 and preserve the complete melody.
Render multiple syllables in one note sequentially with ordered consonants.
Preserve one syllable across pitches with explicit retrigger and short-note diagnostics.
Move the intended phoneme boundary by 30 ms, including tempo changes, within one rounding sample.
Persist onset, rate, depth, fades and phase; apply one oscillation to intended F0.
Render manual local pitch and specified transition duration and shape.
Apply typed loudness curves click-free without claiming gain is vocal effort.
Change consonant placement and attack duration through the phoneme timing plan.
Preserve syllable ownership and intentional retrigger across linked notes.
Persist a reviewed style and audibly blend supported paired material.
Control breath placement, level and release shape with unvoiced handling.
Change noise and voicing balance while retaining intelligibility.
Change vocal effort and spectral shape independently of output gain.
Change spectral envelope independently of ordinary F0.
Control evaluated aperiodic or subharmonic character.
Accept editable pitch, timing, energy and articulation proposals.
Persist alternate takes, seed identity and independently editable harmony.
Every expression has a neutral default and survives undo, recovery, reload, cache reuse and final export.
Design an original female character voice without a supplied human recording and save an editable recipe.
Generate recognisable vowels, consonants, transitions and unseen lyrics across the declared range.
Recipe changes preserve installed bank versions and prior song identity; song pitch does not rewrite voice identity.
Record or import authorized human material, edit, retake, review, package and install through supported actions.
Generate procedural material, edit, regenerate, review, package and install through the same production actions.
Apply per-kind QA, explicit take ownership and revision-bound review invalidation to voiced, breath, pause and closure material.
Publish a complete immutable generation atomically, verify hashes, install and reproduce its bank.
Recover interrupted work; cancellation, stale writers or disk failure preserve previous approved and installed versions.
Resolve every required inventory entry and independently review advertised pitch range on held-out phrases.
Provide at least two reviewed audibly distinct styles without hidden substitution.
Demonstrate supported paired-style blending while preserving pitch and identity.
Japanese dictionary/rules, editable pronunciation, matching approved resources and a native-reviewed saved song.
English dictionary/rules, editable pronunciation, matching approved resources and a native-reviewed saved song.
Korean dictionary/rules, editable pronunciation, matching approved resources and a native-reviewed saved song.
Phone insertion or dictionary change cannot retarget timing locks by ordinal; ambiguous edits remain unresolved and undo restores ownership.
Measure pitch, formants, duration, joins and voiced coverage across each declared sample range.
Retarget voiced transitions while preserving unvoiced detail and independent source mapping.
Bound contextual selection and prove actual control support, Raw behavior, fallback and cached provenance.
Qualify an original singer dataset, leakage-free splits, compatible acoustic model and vocoder with reviewed provenance.
Install the real qualified model on both targets; render, cancel, recover and export an unfamiliar song.
Bind native CPU provider, precision, helper/protocol, processing revisions and runtime dependencies to the installed surface.
Partial regeneration preserves locked channels/ranges, rejects stale take acceptance and avoids double vibrato.
Compare repeatable takes and edit independent harmony notes through undo, reload and export.
Counterbalance manual and assisted tasks on matched unfamiliar material with equal starting tools; compare within-creator correction work and remaining errors.
Finish unequal-note duplication, tempo/meter, lyric distribution and every expression lane using native actions.
Select overlaps, read full long text, tune at narrow layouts and scaled displays using keyboard and assistive semantics.
Import and export the declared USTX subset in the native UI with explicit conversion losses and tempo/PPQ fidelity.
Import and export Standard MIDI Files through the native UI with tempo/meter/PPQ and declared conversion fidelity.
Reject malformed, oversized and executable external references before allocation or unsafe access.
Both standalone platforms complete authoring and live expression with per-note targeting, pan/vibrato/timbre, pedal and panic.

Show actual active singer/style, audition, range and resource status with authorized associated artwork.
Follow rendered mouth/performance states across seek, loop, stop and reload without audio callback dependencies.
Keep narrow layouts, missing artwork, full text and reduced-motion/accessibility state usable.
Enforce input/output, memory, model and generation limits with cancellation and killable deadlines outside the callback.
Reject stale requests, changed context/assets and concurrent writer generations; preserve manual and accepted results.
Recover save, journal, interrupted generation and failures without data loss or hidden success.
Measure warm/cold classical small edits on frozen reference machines against the separate 500 ms p95 workload.
